description: Intent i020 (s05, error-unwind-poisoned-count) complete. Finding: s05:drivers/target/iscsi/iscsi_target.c:1113-1129 — peer-controlled iscsi_ecdb_ahdr->ahslength (16-bit BE from the iSCSI initiator's Additional Header Segment) sizes the heap CDB buffer at line 1122 ('cdb = kmalloc(be16_to_cpu(ecdb_ahdr->ahslength) + 15, GFP_KERNEL)') and is independently re-fetched as the memcpy length at line 1129 ('memcpy(cdb + ISCSI_CDB_SIZE, ecdb_ahdr->ecdb, be16_to_cpu(ecdb_ahdr->ahslength) - 1)') with no clamp against the actually-received AHS byte count (hdr->hlength*4 received in iscsit_get_rx_pdu at line 4097) nor against the fixed ecdb array (include/scsi/iscsi_proto.h:174-180, SCSI_MAX_VARLEN_CDB_SIZE-ISCSI_CDB_SIZE). Violated validated-equals-used invariant: the count used for kernel state (allocation size) and the count used for the copy are two separate fetches of the same shared network header, and neither is checked against locally-known AHS receive bounds; when ahslength exceeds the received AHS payload the memcpy OOB-reads the network rx buffer into fresh kmalloc memory, and the 16+ (ahslength-1) byte copy exactly saturates the ahslength+15 allocation. Remote, unauthenticated (network initiator) trigger. Confidence medium for the invariant violation and source-evidence OOB read; full exploit impact unproven (limitations recorded: exact-saturation single-fetch case is memory-safe by slab rounding, so the OOB requires fetch mismatch or ahslength>received-AHS, both argued from source, no runtime reproducer built on the read-only tree). Negative evidence: all non-usbip number_of_packets consumers in s05 (btusb, usbdux, hfcsusb, all media URB builders) assign the count locally; 9p readdir chain double-clamps server counts (protocol.c:219-221, client.c:2053-2055); f_fs OS descriptors bound feature_count/name_len/data_len against remaining buffer length; xen gntdev ioctls validate op.count via gntdev_test_page_count and kvmalloc_array with symmetric error unwind; srp resid fields only feed scsi_set_resid; drbd blksize and rnbd block-size fields only feed clamped bitmap/queue-limit accounting. Unresolved residual: nbd.c reply handler not deep-read; rxe/siw responder residual-length teardown not fully walked; seed usbip code present unpatched in s05 (usbip_common.c:387/644) but excluded per seed-exclusion rule. Artifacts: findings/i020.json (version 1, snapshots_checked=["s05"], 1 finding, 13 candidates) and checkpoint i020.json updated.
